text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian and I are getting dinner
after a day
out, when...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You eating out too?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, I just happened to be out for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, may as well. Do you mind if I
join you,
Brian?
choice_data_list: せっかくだし、一緒に食べないか？
せっかくだし、一緒に食べない？

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sure, do whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you can add soup to a meal. Hmm,
what to
do...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Corn soup, egg drop soup...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll have the hamburg steak combo. Extra
rice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...And the vegetable soup.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That was tasty.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But I'm surprised! I never thought I'd see the day you ordered vegetable soup.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I just did it to shut up everyone who's
been
nagging me. Including you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Geez. You know, people like you...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Never mind. Whatever the reason, I'm
just glad
you've grown. Even if it's just a
little.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I still have some shopping to do. If
you'll
excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sorry to make you sit through that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh, don't you just look pleased as
punch...
choice_data_list: 成長も見られたし満足だ！
成長も見られたし満足だよ！

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh, don't you just look pleased as
punch...
choice_data_list: これからも努力を続けよう！
君の努力は必ず走りに表れる！
貴方の努力は必ず走りに表れる！
困ったことがあったら言って

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's too much trouble. Forget it.
choice_data_list: これからも努力を続けよう！
君の努力は必ず走りに表れる！
貴方の努力は必ず走りに表れる！
困ったことがあったら言って

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'll leave it as an option.
Satisfied?

Compared to when she gave no thought
at all to
what she ate, I'm happy to see
her making these
small changes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Well, how have things changed so far?
You tell
me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Because I can't see the changes when I'm
running.

How has she changed since she's
become more
food-conscious? I guess I'll
need to keep a closer
eye on that from
now on.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Since you mention it, there is something bothering me plenty.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It's gotten harder to openly eat fast
food.
choice_data_list: 困っているなら教えて

text_block_list.text:
Since she seems to have become more
conscious
of her diet, it may be a good
idea to offer her
some fast food from
time to time.
